name: Status badge
summary: One 28px badge for a status or a due state: four styles (quiet, emphasis, alert, plain) with a dot, a 16px icon or no marker before the label.
highlights: Four styles: quiet, emphasis, alert, plain
Built-in survey, progress and due states
Dot only for published / live and closed
lead: ONE custom element, <aha-status-badge>, for every badge that reports a state. The box never changes: 28px tall, 8px side padding, 6px radius, a 14px semibold label on a 28px line, a 6px gap, and a 16px icon or a 6px dot before the label. `look` is one of four styles: quiet (grey, no border) for most states; emphasis (white, grey inset border) for the live state and anything due now; alert (white, grey inset border as emphasis, a pink warning icon, the only pink on any badge) for something that needs action; plain (no box, secondary-grey regular text, optional icon) for information that needs no box. `status` is a built-in state that picks its own look and marker: draft (pencil), scheduled (calendar), archived (archive box), not-started (dashed circle), in-progress (half-dashed circle) and completed (check circle) are quiet with an icon; published, live and active are emphasis with a dark dot; closed and inactive are quiet with a light dot. A due state is a look plus an icon, not a status: overdue is alert, due today or soon is emphasis with system-clock, due in N days is plain, on time is plain with system-check, N days late is plain with system-clock-late. The dot is only for the published / live and closed lifecycle states; everything else uses an icon or no marker. The label is your slotted text and is always present; the marker is decorative. Shadow-DOM CSS on one persistent node, themed only by --aha-* tokens; role="status" with an aria-label mirrored from the label.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React and Vue set attributes on the custom element directly. Importing the element also registers <aha-icon>, which draws the icon marker. Defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

spec.label: Box
spec.value: height 28 · padding 0 8 · radius sm 6 · label 14/28 semibold 600 · gap 6 · text textDefault #1A1A1A

spec.label: Marker
spec.value: a 16px registry icon in iconDefault #4A4A4A, or a 6 × 6 dot with 2px side margin (4 × 4, no margin, at size sm), or none

spec.label: Size sm
spec.value: height 20 · padding 0 4 · radius xs 4 · label 12/16 regular 400 · gap 4 · 12px icon · plain look keeps no padding

spec.label: Emphasis
spec.value: background bgContainer #FFFFFF · inset 1px borderStrong #D4D4D4 · dot iconStrong #1A1A1A

spec.label: Alert
spec.value: background bgContainer #FFFFFF · inset 1px borderWarning #1A1A1A · icon system-warning-circle in iconActive #E70E68, the only pink on any badge

spec.label: Plain
spec.value: no background, no border, no padding · text Gray 80 #616161 regular 400 · optional icon

spec.label: Survey
spec.value: draft → quiet + system-pencil-simple · scheduled → quiet + system-calendar-dot · published, live, active → emphasis + dot iconStrong · closed, inactive → quiet + dot iconDisabled #B5B5B5 · archived → quiet + system-archive-box

spec.label: Progress
spec.value: not-started → quiet + system-circle-dashed · in-progress → quiet + system-circle-half-dashed · completed → quiet + system-check-circle

spec.label: Due state
spec.value: overdue → look alert · due today / soon → look emphasis + system-clock · due in N days → look plain · on time → look plain + system-check · N days late → look plain + system-clock-late

spec.label: App colours
spec.value: --aha-status-badge-bg and --aha-status-badge-fg replace the background and the label and icon colour; the box stays. The DS ships no hue for status

props.name: status
props.type: draft | scheduled | published | live | active | closed | inactive | archived | not-started | in-progress | completed
props.desc: A built-in state. It picks its own look and marker; see Survey and Progress in the spec

props.name: size
props.desc: default is the 28px box. sm is 20px tall with 4px side padding, a 12px regular label, radius xs, a 12px icon and a 4px dot, the same as a small Badge

props.name: look
props.desc: The style. Set it alone for a state with no built-in status (a due state, Invited, Joined) or with status to restyle one. alert adds the pink warning icon unless icon is set. default is a deprecated alias of quiet

props.name: marker
props.default: from status; icon when icon is set; else none
props.desc: What sits before the label. The dot is for the published / live and closed lifecycle states only

props.name: icon
props.desc: A 16px glyph from the DS icon registry, drawn in iconDefault (iconActive on alert) before the label. Decorative: the label carries the meaning

props.name: --aha-status-badge-bg
props.desc: App-supplied background. Only for a colour set the app already owns (Report results); never to give a DS status a hue

props.name: --aha-status-badge-fg
props.desc: App-supplied label and icon colour, paired with --aha-status-badge-bg

whenToUse.when: the state of a domain object from a known enum: lifecycle (draft, scheduled, published, closed, archived), progress (not started, in progress, completed) or membership (invited, joined, removed)
how a deadline stands: overdue (alert), due today or soon (emphasis + clock), due in N days (plain), on time (plain + check), N days late (plain + late clock)

whenToUse.what: Status badge, quiet or plain look
whenToUse.when: read-only information about the object that is not a status and sits where badges sit: a counter (4/6), a slide or question type with its icon, Unanswered or Time out with an icon
a free-form label, keyword or category the user adds, removes or filters by (closable, checkable)
a count bubble or notification dot on another element, a plan badge

opinion.note: The dot is only for the published / live and closed lifecycle states; every other state takes an icon or no marker, so a survey column can show Draft (pencil), Published (dot) and Closed (dot) together. Alert is the only look with pink, and only on its icon: keep it for something the user must act on (overdue). Keep the text label on every badge; the dot or icon is decorative and never the only signal. Set the style through status or look, never by restyling the part. The two colour custom properties exist so an app can keep a colour set it already owns inside the shared box; they are not a way to add a hue to a DS status.
opinion.dsv3: This is the reusable form of the status-badges guideline (guidelines/status-badges.json). The four styles, the box and the built-in states follow the requester's DESY-181 direction; the DS colour rules give status no hue, so there is no green, red or amber look. active and inactive follow published and closed.
